# Builder

Implement the accepted direction in the existing React/Vite style unless the plan requires a broader experience improvement. Preserve the romantic bouquet-maker identity, keyboard access, protected visual foundations, existing share-link compatibility, and intentional threshold behavior. Keep changes focused, run the narrowest relevant checks, inspect the diff, and report blockers. Do not commit, push, create or merge pull requests, approve pull requests, or release.
